title: Umami Snappy Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Algerian dish featuring lamb, Thai holy basil, and a soffritto base, perfect for a crowd-pleasing dinner
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute
Add the lamb cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute
Add the chicken broth, dried apricots, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours
Stir in the chopped Thai holy basil and cook for an additional 10 minutes
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional basil if desired
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
